title: Lead funnel
source: Google Ads API (4467722415) + CallRail API (All Seasons Air). Refreshed by Claude and from the Command Center.
notes: Taps and calls don't match one to one: some people tap and hang up, others read the number and dial by hand.
Website calls tie to a campaign through the visitor's Google click ID. Calls without a match show as not tied to a campaign (under All).
Counted as taps: Click to call. Forms: Submit lead form, [TSD] Lead Form. Ad-button calls: Calls from Smart Campaign Ads, Calls from Ads New, call extension LEAD. Sent back to Google: Phone Call.
Google Ads numbers for today and yesterday can still change for a few hours as Google finishes processing.
